_providerToken_note: The `pt` value. Apple GENERATES this the first time you create a campaign link in App Store Connect — you cannot invent one. ASC only shows the Campaigns tab once the app has analytics data, so this may not be obtainable yet. See RESEARCH.md §5.2. While it is null, make-slideshow.mjs emits the plain App Store URL and says so in the deck's manifest.
_redirectBase_note: Set 2026-09-25 after verifying GET /g/test returns 302 to apps.apple.com on the live service. A post link is <redirectBase>/<deckId>-<tt|ig>.
_handle_note: Set 2026-09-26 — the real TikTok and Instagram username is myargusai. Printed on every slide footer; regenerate if it changes.
_tiktokAccount_note: Set 2026-09-26: a TikTok Business account couldn't be created, so TikTok is a PERSONAL account. Personal accounts can't link to App Store pages (RESEARCH §1.4), so TikTok copy must never say 'link in bio' — the TikTok CTA says to search “My Argus” on the App Store (it ranks #1 for that, 2026-09-26, but another app with the same name is #2 — hence 'look for the gold ring'). Validation enforces this for every deck. Upside: personal accounts get the full sound library. Set to "business" if that account ever exists.
_instagramBioLink_note: Set 2026-10-04: the Instagram profile has no link in its bio, so Instagram copy must never say 'link in bio' — it says to search “My Argus” on the App Store, like TikTok. Validation enforces this for every deck. Remove (or set true) once the bio has the link.
_tiktokFormat_note: Set 2026-10-04: "carousel" — the browser bot posts the slides as a swipeable PHOTO post with a sound from TikTok’s picker (TikTok Studio’s upload page now has a Photos tab and an Add sound button; it was video-only on 2026-09-26). "video" goes back to a silent slideshow video (lib/video.mjs) and drops the hook slide’s SWIPE cue — the fallback if the Photos tab disappears. Slides are rendered per format, so decks made before a change keep their old cue.
_instagramFormat_note: Set 2026-10-04: "carousel-sound" — swipeable AND with sound: a 4:5 carousel whose slides are 8-second video clips of each slide over a music track from assets/music/ (Instagram's website has no music picker — checked on the real page — but a carousel may hold videos, and a video carries its own audio). Rollie's standing rule: every post has scrollable slides and audio. "reel" is one 9:16 slideshow video with the music (sound, not swipeable); "carousel" is a silent swipeable 4:5 photo post. Slides are rendered per format, so decks made before a change keep their old size.
_memeHook_note: Set 2026-10-07 (Rollie: a meme on slide 1 to stop the scroll). The writer gives every new deck's hook slide a "meme" caption and a reaction-shot photo (scripts/make-images.mjs MEME_STYLE — the one slide where generated faces are allowed). The caption is written in a format people are using this week (the trend scout, lib/trends.mjs — phrasing only, Rollie 2026-10-09) over our own generated photo: never an existing meme image, a celebrity, a character, a song or a brand, because those are someone else's copyright or likeness in what is an ad. Set false to go back to the plain photo hook; decks already written keep whatever they have.
